page: Amazon Web Services c8id.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 192 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 5700 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities and high memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier performance in Geekbench multi-core testing, software compilation with Clang, and ray tracing. It also demonstrates top-tier results in Passmark CPU, database operations, and Redis SET operations, processing 166.59 million operations per second. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate cryptographic tasks and low-precision matrix math.

Given its high compute density, fast DDR5 memory, and substantial local NVMe storage, the c8id.24xlarge is highly efficient for workloads requiring rapid local data access and heavy CPU processing. It is well-suited for database hosting, high-throughput web serving, software compilation pipelines, and large-scale multi-threaded applications. The inclusion of 5.7 TB of local NVMe SSD storage offers a cost-effective alternative to provisioning equivalent external block storage for high-I/O workloads.
